source.title: Maximum Difference Score in a Grid

teaching.hint: What happens to the intermediate cell values when several move scores are added?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Path differences cancel to endpoint minus start. Reachable starts form the endpoint prefix rectangle, excluding the endpoint itself.
solution_outline.approach: Sweep endpoints in row order. Maintain prefix rectangle minima; the minimum from the rectangle above or left is the best legal predecessor. Update the score before incorporating the current cell into the prefix minimum.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: Before incorporating a cell, the above and left minima jointly cover exactly all coordinate-wise earlier cells distinct from it.
solution_outline.correctness: Every nonempty monotone route has total equal to its last value minus its first. Conversely each distinct coordinate-wise predecessor reaches the endpoint by downward and rightward moves. For a fixed endpoint, selecting the smallest such start maximizes its score; all endpoints are inspected, so the maximum is global.
solution_outline.complexity: O(mn) time and O(n) space with a rolling row of prefix minima.
solution_outline.pitfall: Including the current cell as its own start admits an illegal zero-move score and loses negative optima.

common_wrong_turns: Including the current cell as its own start admits an illegal zero-move score and loses negative optima.
source_fidelity_notes: Restated down/right moves using same-row or same-column coordinates; retained arbitrary endpoints, nonadjacent jumps, and at least one move. Omitted the incorrect sentinel-overflow claim.
